input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, e-commerce domain. It serves API Consumer, Admin, Customer, System, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include s security bootstrap, hello world, hello world rest. Core business data revolves around AutowiredBeanHolder, User. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.
